scene.description: Generate a high-resolution, photorealistic image of three young adults in a modern, brightly lit airport terminal, captured with the aesthetic of a professional smartphone photograph — sharp focus, natural lighting, and a slightly wide-angle perspective. The scene is set on a luggage carousel, with one person seated on the edge of the carousel while the other two stand nearby, creating a dynamic, candid composition. Subject 1 (Left): A young woman with dark, shoulder-length hair, wearing a navy blue V-neck top and blue jeans, sits on the carousel. She is wearing a light blue surgical face mask and has a red-and-black plaid backpack slung over her shoulder. She is focused on a silver laptop resting on her lap, her gaze directed at the screen. Her posture is relaxed but attentive, with one leg bent and the other extended. She wears beige sneakers. Subject 2 (Center): A woman with long, wavy brown hair, wearing a wide-brimmed beige hat, a white tank top under a denim jacket, and blue jeans. She stands smiling warmly, looking toward the man on the right. She carries a large cream-colored tote bag with a red heart design, and her hands are casually placed on her luggage handles. She has a friendly, cheerful expression and wears a simple silver necklace and a wristwatch. Subject 3 (Right): A man with curly brown hair and a light beard, wearing a gray t-shirt and blue jeans, stands with his luggage. He is looking at the woman in the center with a gentle, engaged expression. He has a black backpack over one shoulder and is holding the handle of a red suitcase. His posture is open and relaxed. Luggage: Three suitcases are visible — a red rolling suitcase with the man, a red suitcase with the woman in the center, and a black rolling suitcase in front of her. All suitcases have retractable handles and appear to be made of durable, smooth plastic with zippers and side handles. Background: The airport terminal features a clean, modern aesthetic with white ceilings, recessed lighting, and large windows allowing natural light to flood in. Rows of empty beige airport seats are visible in the background, along with a digital display showing “10” in bright yellow numerals on a dark screen. A few other travelers are faintly visible in the distance, blurred slightly to keep focus on the main subjects. Lighting: Bright, diffused daylight with soft overhead artificial lighting. The white balance is neutral to slightly warm, enhancing the natural, inviting mood. Colors are vibrant but not oversaturated — the reds of the suitcases, the denim, and the beige hat stand out against the cool, clean tones of the terminal. Composition: The camera is positioned at eye level, slightly angled to capture the three subjects in a natural, conversational arrangement. The focus is sharp on the subjects, with a shallow depth of field blurring the background slightly to emphasize the interaction. The carousel curves gently into the frame, adding a sense of motion and context. Mood: Friendly, casual, and upbeat — capturing a moment of travel companionship and anticipation. The scene feels authentic and contemporary, with no artificial staging. Style: Photorealistic, high-definition, smartphone-captured photo quality — no visible grain or noise, clean textures, and crisp details on clothing, luggage, and facial features. The image has a polished, cinematic feel but remains grounded in real-world realism. Legible text: A digital airport display in the background clearly shows the number “10” in yellow, indicating gate or departure information. Note: Avoid any studio lighting or artificial set design. The setting is an open, real-world airport environment with natural and artificial light sources.
